description: Retrospective application for erection of a single storey rear extension to the restaurant
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([SYL/20/476-78/1], [SYL/20/476-78/2], [SYL/20/476-78/3], [SYL/20/476-78/4], [SYL/20/476-78/5], [SYL/20/476-78/6], [SYL/20/476-78/7], [SYL/20/476-78/8], Received: 08/01/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - Within three months of the date of this permission a secure storage area within the site [476-478 Great West Road, TW5 0TA] enclosed by a two metre high close boarded fence or within the property, to house not less than two 1100 litre galvanised steel Eurobins shall be made available, together with facilities for the separation and safe storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling.  If such a provision cannot be made, the waste bins shall be stored within the building.  The storage area and bins shall be made permanently available before the development is first occupied and no waste shall be stored outside the site or other than in the designated area.  The lids of the Eurobins shall be fixed shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them.  Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.  Waste shall be removed from the site to a suitable enclosed private storage area or an authorised refuse disposal or recycling site as soon as the bins become full if this is earlier than the time of the normal collection, unless additional covered and enclosed bins (as described above) have been provided and are thereafter made permanently available for the on-site storage of refuse and waste.
